name: dispatch-platform
description: Dispatch rider & logistics management platform (customer, rider, admin portals)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @dispatch/api" "npm run dev --workspace @dispatch/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @dispatch/api && npm run build --workspace @dispatch/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @dispatch/api && npm run lint --workspace @dispatch/web
scripts.setup: bash ./scripts/dev-env-up.sh && npm install && npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
